description: This PHP class 'Log' provides an interface for logging functions within the AWS CRT library, including logging to stdout, stderr, files, streams, and setting log levels.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class for managing logging outputs and levels in the AWS CRT context.

methods.name: toFile
methods.description: Logs output to a specified file.

methods.name: toStream
methods.description: Logs output to a specified stream resource.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level by asserting the input is within defined constant bounds.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level.
